text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer. Could I get the usual?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (THUD, SMACK, WHACK!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving her a spirit-boosting shoulder 
massage, I checked the condition of her 
body.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tone in her muscles... was slowly 
returning. However, recovery was far too 
slow. Her body was still nowhere near 
ready to fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That, too—was only natural.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, haah... haah... gasp...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exhaustion from the Kawasaki Kinen 
still lingers heavily. The price paid for 
preparing as if dedicating one's entire 
life...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The people she wished to see recover are 
steadily getting back on their feet. A 
dream's... sublimation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Smart Falcon. The guiding falcon had 
flown off across the sea.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Every possible measure was exhausted. Yet 
the exhaustion ran so deep that no remedy 
could reach it, and above all, there was 
no way to rekindle their spirit."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What more... can I possibly do...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. Well then, Trainer, I reckon 
it's time for me to head out.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Today, I've got a few thoughts on my mind. 
So~...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Will you keep your eyes on me? Watch how I 
run.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was none of Wonder Acute's usual 
excitement in those words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHH)

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, Wonder Acute... Seeing her 
again after all this time, she seems 
kinda..."

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Did I become more like a granny? 
Well, I've always been kind of like a 
granny anyway.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know how far I can run. Even 
so...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(I gotta run with everything I've got, in 
my own way. I'll do everything I can... 
and if...)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, if my eyes get bleary and I 
can't see the finish line well, then at 
that time—)
